interestingFact: India is home to the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
The United States has 63 national parks and the world's largest economy.
Japan has more than 6,800 islands and is famous for its bullet trains.
Australia is home to the Great Barrier Reef, the largest coral reef system in the world.
The Eiffel Tower was originally intended to stand for only 20 years.
Germany is famous for its castles, engineering, and the Autobahn with no general speed limit.
Brazil is home to the Amazon Rainforest, the largest tropical rainforest in the world.
Canada has the longest coastline of any country in the world.
The Great Wall of China stretches over 21,000 kilometers.
Italy is home to the world's smallest country, Vatican City.
Big Ben is actually the nickname of the Great Bell inside the famous clock tower.
Russia spans 11 time zones, more than any other country.
South Korea has one of the fastest internet speeds in the world.
Mexico introduced chocolate, tomatoes, and avocados to the world.
South Africa has three official capital cities.
The Great Pyramid of Giza is the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
Spain produces nearly half of the world's olive oil.
Argentina is the birthplace of the tango dance.
New Zealand was the first country to give women the right to vote.
Norway is famous for its breathtaking fjords and the Midnight Sun.
